reviewItem.question: Does "`cilium_identity_label_sources` is a new metric which counts the number of identities with per label source" mean a change to api-endpoint:cilium|name=cilium_identity_label_sources (added)?

proposed.statement: Cilium 1.16 adds a new metric, cilium_identity_label_sources, counting identities per label source (e.g. separate fqdn and cidr label metrics); no operational consequence.
